SamenvattingJoin our team at DHL in Weert and play a key role in ensuring orders are accurate and delivered on time. GC Corporation was founded in Japan in 1921 and has grown to become one of the leading companies in the development, manufacture, and distribution of a very wide range of dental products. Since 1972, our European headquarters, GC Europe NV, has been located in Leuven, Belgium. The GC Group includes several subsidiaries within Europe, whose development, manufacturing, and distribution of products for specific areas of dentistry and dental technology round out our product portfolio. Our warehouses distribute our products throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Tasks

- Build and maintain strong relationships with orthodontists, dental professionals, and key customers.

- Introduce new products, communicate innovations, and support sales campaigns to customers.

- Identify new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, referrals, networking, trade shows, and industry events.

- Act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring timely follow-up and excellent customer service.

- Understand customer needs through consultative conversations and recommend suitable orthodontic solutions based on individual requirements.

- Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and sales meetings using professional sales materials and clinical knowledge.

- Drive sales growth by presenting customer-focused solutions and demonstrating the value of the GC Orthodontics portfolio.

- Maintain accurate customer records, sales activities, and follow-up actions in the CRM system.

- Develop and execute territory plans to maximize customer retention and business growth.

- Collaborate closely with internal teams, including Marketing, Customer Service, and Product Management, to ensure excellent customer experience.

- Continuously develop product knowledge, sales skills, and industry expertise through training, coaching, and professional development activities.

Requirements

- Fluent in Dutch and English; German language skills are considered an advantage

Cheese factory operator 
As a cheese dairy operator, you are responsible for draining, pressing, and brining high-quality specialty cheeses. In addition, you are also responsible for making our dairy products, such as yogurt and quark. The role is therefore very diverse! You will be taught the cheese-making process by our best cheesemakers. The duties of a drainer involve ensuring that the curd is prepared for pressing into cheese (this is done by hand). You ensure that the cheeses are placed in the cheese vats and that the cheeses are turned. Additionally, you assist with cleaning equipment and machines and are responsible for a hygienic working environment. 
We ask 
• You have completed at least an MBO level 3 education 
• You are available 36-40 hours, on weekdays, but also on weekends and during the evenings 
(working days are normally from Monday to Friday and working hours vary across 4 shifts, NO NIGHT SHIFT) 
• You are attentive, accurate, flexible, and stress-resistant 
• You speak and write fluent Dutch (English is a plus) 
• Knowledge of the food industry 
• You are proactive, quality-conscious, and have an independent work attitude 
We offer 
• A 36-40 hour work week with varying working hours (shifts) 
• An inspiring and dynamic work environment 
• Room for personal initiative 
• No-nonsense culture 
• An enthusiastic team of colleagues 
• Training opportunities

Studio Louter 
 Internship visual 
content design 
We're looking for highly motivated and ambitious visual design interns. Positions are available twice a year, roughly from February through July and from September through January. Interns at Studio Louter get to work on award-winning projects for museums around the world. 
 What you'll do 
As an intern, you'll be a fully fledged member of the team and work on different projects. - 
You'll contribute to the visualisation of concepts and design for exhibitions, interactives and films - 
Your duties will range from image editing to screen design - 
You'll experience the design process and contact with customers and partners - 
You'll give at least one presentation to the entire team on a subject of your choice during your internship - 
You'll help with day-to-day tasks in the studio 
More information about our projects , who we are and how we work can be found on this website. 
 What we ask 
We're looking for someone with a relevant education at HBO (college) level, preferably in graphic or multimedia design. - 
You are enrolled at an university - 
You have experience with Adobe software (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD) and you also dare to sketch on paper - 
You are able to work independently and have a flexible attitude - 
You are enthusiastic and a hard worker - 
You are interested in museums and exhibitions. - 
You are detail-oriented - 
You are keen to work at a creative company - 
You are able to speak and write in English
